d:
Ben Lane and Sean Vendy had to go all out in order to overcome champions Fajar Alfian and Muhammad Rian Ardianto.
After going down 15-21 in the opening game, the English duo held their nerve to clinch the subsequent games 23-21, 21-15 against the Indonesian pair to clinch the quarter-final berth.
Watch them in action from 3:30 pm on 1 / 1 HD
